en.title: Count Products of Powers of 3 and 5 in a Range
en.description:
Count the integers in the closed interval [low,high] that can be written as 3^x×5^y, where x,y are both non-negative; 1 is valid, and each value is counted only once.

The standard input/output format and examples were compiled by this site; ranges explicitly marked as this site's are not the source's original constraints.
en.input: One line containing low high. The source gives no numeric bounds; on this site −2^63≤low≤high≤2^63−1.
hints: Generate, layer by layer, the powers of 3 not exceeding high and the values obtained by multiplying them by 5, and count those not less than low; check the upper bound with division before multiplying.
